description: Dynamoi helps artists and labels create free Spotify Smart Links, review music-promotion campaigns and analytics, and handle music-distribution applications from ChatGPT. Users can check the exact five distribution requirements and submit an eligible application for manual review after explicit confirmation. Application submission does not approve distribution, accept an agreement, submit releases, or deliver music to stores. This ChatGPT app surface does not collect payment, start paid campaign launches, mutate live campaign budgets, or begin external OAuth connection flows; those steps stay in the Dynamoi dashboard.

defaultPrompt: Show me what the four Dynamoi Smart Link themes can look like for a release called Demo Review Single by 92 Keys.
